sections.text_helper: Section 25.7.10 "EXTI software interrupt event register (EXTI_SWIER2)" in chapter 25 (Extended interrupts and event controller (EXTI)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1141.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x028
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
This register contains only bits for configurable events.
Bits 31:25 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Extended interrupts and event controller (EXTI)
Bit 24 SWI56: Software interrupt on event 56
0: Writing 0 has no effect.
1: Writing 1 to this bit triggers a rising edge event on event x (bit auto cleared by hardware).
l When SECx is disabled in EXTI_SECCFGR2, SWIx can be accessed with non-secure
and secure access.
l When SECx is enabled in EXTI_SECCFGR2, SWIx can be accessed only with secure
access. Nonsecure write to SWIx is discarded. Nonsecure read returns 0.
l When PRIVx is disabled in EXTI_PRIVCFGR2, SWIx can be accessed with unprivileged
and privileged access.
l When PRIVx is enabled in EXTI_PRIVCFGR2, SWIx can be accessed only with
privileged access. Unprivileged write to SWIx is discarded. Unprivileged read returns 0.
l A software interrupt is generated whatever the setting in EXTI_RTSR and EXTI_FTSR. It
always returns 0 when read.
Bit 23 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 22 SWI54: Software interrupt on event 54
Bits 21:20 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 19 SWI51: Software interrupt on event 51
Bits 18:9 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 8:7 SWIx: Software interrupt on event x (x = 40 to 39)
Bits 6:0 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
